title: Consideration of Matters Regarding Member of Parliament
what_it_is: Consideration of Matters Regarding Member of Parliament

sections.label: CPIB investigations discussion caution
sections.summary: The House should not discuss CPIB or Police investigations of an MP's personal conduct, and such discussion will be ruled irrelevant and disallowed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: In respect of speeches on these two Motions, the House should not be discussing the ongoing Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau (CPIB) or Police investigations of any particular Member of Parliament's (MP) personal conduct and what possible offences may have been committed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I advise Members at the onset to exercise caution in discussing or reflecting on such matters as it could prejudice investigations or prejudge such a Member.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Pursuant to Standing Order 50(1), any discussion on the CPIB or Police investigations, and an MP’s personal conduct will be ruled as irrelevant to the subject matter under discussion and will be disallowed by me.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: At the direction of the Prime Minister, he has been interdicted in his capacity as a Minister on a reduced pay of $8,500 per month, until further notice, as explained by the Prime Minister in his Ministerial Statement delivered at the last Sitting on 2 August 2023.

sections.label: Three MPs under investigation
sections.summary: Three Members of Parliament are under investigation: Mr Iswaran, Mr Pritam Singh and Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: At the moment, there are three Members of Parliament under investigation: Mr Iswaran, Mr Pritam Singh and Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap.

sections.label: Iswaran CPIB investigation
sections.summary: Mr Iswaran is under investigation by CPIB under the Prevention of Corruption Act.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: All we know at this point in time is that Mr Iswaran is under investigation by CPIB under the Prevention of Corruption Act.

sections.label: Premature action on Iswaran
sections.summary: Taking action against Mr Iswaran now is premature and would prejudge the outcome of the investigation.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As such, Mr Speaker, it is premature to take any action with regard to Mr Iswaran at this stage and doing so would be to prejudge the outcome of the investigation.
